select distinct t1.id, t1.code, t1.name, t1.description, t1.people, t1.status, t1.create_time from bm_product_plan_team t1 left join bm_resource_permission t2 on t1.id = t2.resource_id
and t1.code like concat('%', #{code}, '%')
and t1.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and t2.dept_id in
#{deptId}
order by t1.create_time desc

select t1.id, t1.code, t1.name from bm_product_plan_team t1
and t1.code like concat('%', #{code}, '%')
and t1.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and t1.status = #{status}
order by t1.create_time desc
select t1.id from bm_product_plan_team t1 where t1.people like concat('%',#{userId},'%')

select distinct t1.id, t1.code, t1.name, t1.description, t1.create_time from bm_product_plan_team t1 left join bm_team_production_line t2 on t1.id = t2.team_id
t1.is_deleted = 0 and t1.status = 'TRUE'
and t2.production_line_id in
#{lineId}

select distinct t1.id, t1.code, t1.name, t1.description, t1.create_time, t1.`status`, t1.is_deleted from bm_product_plan_team t1 where t1.id in
#{id}
